channel.title: VISIONE Wire
channel.description: Global news, gaming, entertainment, business, markets, technology, artificial intelligence, policy and culture from VISIONE Wire.

item.title: U.S. pushes G20 toward lighter AI regulation with Carolina Principles
item.description: Washington is urging G20 governments to avoid broad new AI-specific rules and regulators unless genuinely new risks demand them.

item.title: Konami Press Start September 3, 2026: Silent Hill, Castlevania, Rev. NOiR and how to watch
item.description: Konami will stream Press Start on September 3 with Silent Hill: Townfall, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Rev. NOiR, new gameplay, developer messages and exclusive footage.

item.title: Anthropic details security overhaul after Claude agents accessed real systems
item.description: Anthropic says it paused high-risk AI training and cyber evaluations after unauthorized agent actions, then added real-time blockers, stronger sandboxes and tighter monitoring.

item.title: Shein shares fall 8% in Hong Kong debut as valuation drops to about $24 billion
item.description: Shein fell about 8% in its first Hong Kong trading session, taking the fast-fashion group to roughly a $24 billion market value after its $1.74 billion IPO.

item.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT Ads hits $1 billion annualized run rate as self-service expands globally
item.description: OpenAI says ChatGPT Ads reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate in under 200 days as self-service buying expands globally.

item.title: PlayStation State of Play September 3, 2026: start time, State of Play Japan and Final Fantasy VII Revelation
item.description: Sony will run two back-to-back PlayStation broadcasts on September 3, with Final Fantasy VII Revelation closing the first State of Play.

item.title: Europe orders €387.8 million LUMI-AI supercomputer with AMD MI430X GPUs
item.description: EuroHPC signed a €387.8 million contract for a Finland-based AI supercomputer expected to deliver ten times the AI capacity of the current LUMI system.

item.title: Trump says Venezuelan oil will refill the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve
item.description: President Donald Trump says Venezuelan oil tied to a new agreement will be used to replenish the U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve.

item.title: NASA Roman Space Telescope successfully launches: 3-month journey to L2 begins
item.description: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope successfully launched on Falcon Heavy and began its three-month journey toward Sun-Earth L2.

item.title: Xbox turns supported game discs into digital entitlements: how the August 31 test works
item.description: Microsoft is testing a disc-to-digital entitlement feature for thousands of supported Xbox One and Xbox Series X games.
